mapper.insert: INSERT INTO desktop_device_tokens(user_id, token_hash, device_name, expires_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{deviceName}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, device_name, created_at, last_used_at, expires_at, revoked_at FROM desktop_device_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_used_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO desktop_sso_tokens(user_id, token_hash, redirect_path, expires_at, otp_verified) VALUES(#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{redirectPath}, #{expiresAt}, #{otpVerified})
